focus_areas: Structural integrity and continuity of the metal ring mechanism
Spatial grounding and depth separation from the background
Legibility of text on spine and papers
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the metal ring mechanism; AI often struggles with the complex geometry and specular highlights of metal rings, resulting in 'melted' or blob-like appearances. Use the topology_boundary_auditor to strictly verify if the ring is a continuous, rigid structure or if it collapses/fuses with adjacent elements. Additionally, use the geometric_depth_auditor to ensure the binder is not blending into the background, a common failure mode for rigid objects in AI generation. Scrutinize the text within the clear pocket and on the spine—illegible, warped, or pseudo-text is a high-confidence signal of generation.
